name: retention
title: Finished resource retention
summary: Forgets finished terminals once no layout shows them, so ended programs don't pile up.
description: A finished terminal stays while a layout shows it. When its last view closes (or Close ended tabs runs) it is forgotten: the backend releases it and its id is retired. Finished terminals that were never shown keep the newest 64 for the sidebar's ended items; older ones are forgotten. Live programs are never touched. Only for backends declaring resource.forget (herdr, tmux). retention.forget_ended forgets every unshown finished terminal at once. Turn it off to keep every finished terminal.
